title: Washington Fishing Map
identified: 2026-10-18, named by Daniel when asking for improvements
what: One map on one URL: Recent reports, Typical season and Spawning modes under one thin control bar, plus three layers from the Layers menu: Seasons (Washington Fishing Year seasons outlined by month, with a month slider and ends-soon/opens-soon tags), Spot guides (Three Friends Fishing Hole in Kent) Piers and shore (63 WDFW piers and 80 shore access sites, no rating) and Creel counts (last week's fish kept beside each surveyed report river). Six spot guides around Puget Sound. The old Week, Year, Spots and Counts paths redirect into the map. Counts and timing never mix with ratings.
note: Refresh by PASSING THIS URL with file_path=Artifacts/salmon-rivers/index.html and files= any changed paths from `files` (files left out are kept on the live page). Read the live version first.
